subject: SKU sharing & reseller tax-stamping for co-sell listings — billing path options
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@blueskycloud.com>

Cc: accounts-payable@blueskycloud.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SKU sharing & reseller tax-stamping for co-sell listings — billing path options

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. We're in the final stages of mapping SKUs for our co-sell listing (AWS and Azure) and hit a couple of billing/tax decisions we want to align on before we go live. Two quick questions:

1) For customers in the EU, can Redwood surface Redwood's VAT registration on the marketplace listing (so BlueSky can be listed as reseller but Redwood shows as registered supplier)? Or do you only support reseller-pass-through billing (BlueSky as seller-of-record)?

2) For US-based customers, we need Redwood's W-9 on file if Redwood remains the seller on invoices. If Redwood is not the seller, BlueSky will need a W-8/W-9 depending on entity status.

Attached is a sample invoice we typically use (shows how our AP team expects tax stamping and line-item SKUs). Can you confirm what evidence Redwood can provide (VAT reg, EU tax no, W-9, sample invoice) and which billing path you prefer for marketplace vs direct co-sell?

AP contact for BlueSky: accounts-payable@blueskycloud.com

Goal: decide the billing path this week so we can update the marketplace listing metadata and avoid re-issuance of invoices post-launch.

Thanks —
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
BlueSky Cloud Partners

Attachments: bluesky_sample_invoice.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@blueskycloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU sharing & reseller tax-stamping for co-sell listings — billing path options

Oliver —

Appreciate the sample, that helps. Short answers up front, then next steps.

A) Supported billing patterns
- Marketplace SOR (seller-of-record): marketplace bills the end customer and Redwood shows as supplier on invoice metadata (we can surface our VAT/registration info to the marketplace). This is the cleanest for Redwood for EU VAT purposes.
- Reseller passthrough (BlueSky SOR): BlueSky issues the customer invoice; Redwood invoices BlueSky (or provides monthly settlement). This is common for partner-led deals where the partner requires control of customer billing.

B) Tax evidence we can provide
- EU: Redwood can provide VAT registration number and a PDF proof of registration for the listing.
- US: Redwood can provide a W-9 (we'll send the completed W-9 form).

C) What we need from BlueSky
- Confirmation of which flows you want per-cloud (AWS vs Azure vs direct sales).
- BlueSky's tax residency (country) and entity type so we know if W-8BEN-E is required.
- AP contact + preferred invoice format (your sample is fine).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll attach our reseller onboarding form for AP/legal (redwood_reseller_onboarding_form.pdf) and an initial reseller terms draft (reseller_terms_draft_v1.docx). Please have your legal/AP review and mark any blocking items.
2) If BlueSky wants SOR in the EU for marketplace listings, we (Redwood) will provide VAT registration evidence and a W-9 for US deals.
3) We should sync 30 minutes next week to lock the mapping and timeline.

Can you confirm the preferred path and whether BlueSky will sign the reseller terms or have a standalone SOR agreement with the marketplace? If you prefer, loop in your legal and I'll loop in our contracts contact (Marissa).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_reseller_onboarding_form.pdf (form), reseller_terms_draft_v1.docx (draft)

On Fri, Sep 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Oliver —
> Appreciate the sample, that helps. Short answers up front, then next steps.

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- For AWS listings we prefer BlueSky as SOR in APAC and US (we handle customer billing), but in the EU we'd like to act as reseller SOR for customer relationships. That means BlueSky will issue the invoice to EU customers; Redwood will invoice BlueSky monthly as settlement.
- BlueSky is registered in the UK (GB) and will provide our VAT registration number to you separately. For EU customers we typically ask for supplier VAT evidence to support our settlement and reverse-charge handling.
- We will upload a signed W-8BEN-E if Redwood requires it (BlueSky is non-US).
- AP contact is ap@blueskycloud.com (cc'd).

We reviewed the reseller_terms_draft_v1.docx — two redlines from legal: 1) explicit SLA on invoice delivery timing, 2) a clause about disputed charges and 30-day hold. I'll send annotated copy.

Timeline: if Redwood can provide VAT reg proof + W-9 by next Wednesday (2026-09-15), we can finalize SKU mapping and push the updated listing metadata by 2026-09-18.

Attaching our sample invoice again for your finance team.

Regards,
Oliver

Attachments: bluesky_sample_invoice.pdf
